ns2:section.sectionText: This course will cover the major functions of the sensory systems and the mechanisms of sensation and perception at the molecular, cellular, and systems levels. In addition, it considers the physiological basis of sensory system development, plasticity, and disease based upon human clinical data and research in animal models. Prerequisite: MCB 314 This section of this course counts as an advanced MCB course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Biochemistry or Molecular and Cellular Biology major(s).
